attr.title: Fear & Hunger
attr.desc: A dark and unforgiving dungeon crawler RPG: a party of mercenaries descends into the dungeons of Fear & Hunger, where hunger, sanity and every limb count.
attr.inst: Needs Fear & Hunger 1.4.1 for Windows (itch.io or Steam). Compress its folder www/ into www.zip (a zip without compression is best; a compressed one also works, the first start takes longer) and copy it into ports/fearandhunger/, next to port.toml.
